minimax-m2.5-free.task_description: So, I've been thinking about upgrading the power supply in my small form factor PC, since my old one isn't quite cutting it anymore. I'm mainly looking for reliable options that are compatible with compact cases—ideally stuff that's been proven to work well as replacements for those 350W flex ATX supplies. Reviews really matter to me, so I'd like to stick to accessories and electronics that have at least an 80% positive feedback rate, and it’d be great if people mention things like reliability or compatibility in their comments. I’ve been poking around a bit online and noticed some chatter about good replacement units, but I’d love your take on what actually stands out. Any suggestions for products that fit the bill? Just hoping for a list of solid recommendations with real user feedback—doesn’t have to be perfect, as long as the quality is there.
